tools.name: docs
tools.description: Use For Paths / Props / Component Defs / Component Usage / Model Definitions - Gets the documentation and type definitions and props of a component or set of components or function using glob patterns. USE ME IF YOU KNOW WHAT YOU ARE LOOKING FOR

pattern.title: Glob Pattern
pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files (e.g., 'packages/ui/**/*.tsx', '**/*BaseModel.ts', 'packages/ui/src/components/Button.tsx'). Use ** for recursive search, * for wildcards.

component.title: Component Name
component.description: (Optional) The specific component or interface name to extract from matched files (e.g., Button, ButtonProps). If omitted, shows all exports in matched files.

tools.name: typecheck
tools.description: Type Checks the monorepo bun project properly.  ONLY USE ME FOR TYPE CHECKING

package.title: Package Name
package.description: the folder of the app or package to typecheck, i.e. models / ui / admin

tools.name: lint
tools.description: Lints the monorepo bun project properly. ONLY USE ME FOR LINTING

package.title: Package Name
package.description: the folder of the app or package to typecheck, i.e. models / ui / admin

file.title: File Name
file.description: (Optional) specific file to lint within the package

tools.name: plop_form_modal
tools.description:
Create a Form Modal component using Plop generator.

Generates a TypeScript React component for a form modal with proper templating.

destpath.title: Destination Path
destpath.description: The path where the modal component will be created (e.g., apps/admin/src/components/modals).

name.title: Modal Name
name.description: The name of the modal component (will be converted to PascalCase).

tools.name: plop_pod
tools.description:
Create a complete Pod (model, services, components, and routes) using Plop generator.

Generates a full CRUD pod with model definitions, services, admin components, and routing. This is the most comprehensive generator that creates:
- Model files with validation rules
- Service classes
- Admin CRUD pages (Index, New, Edit, Details)
- Form components and modals
- Next.js routing files

name.title: Model Name
name.description: The name of the model in snake_case (e.g., cool_model).

pluralName.title: Model Plural Name
pluralName.description: The plural form of the model name in snake_case (e.g., cool_models).
